description_en: Queries the details of edge agent packages
description_zh: 查询边缘智能体套餐包详细信息
name: DescribeEdgeMobileAgentPackages

parameters.help_en: The list of package IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas
parameters.help_zh: 套餐ID列表，多个ID用逗号分隔
parameters.name: package_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of license keys. Separate multiple keys with commas
parameters.help_zh: 许可证 Key列表，多个ID用逗号分隔
parameters.name: license_keys

parameters.help_en: The device type filter. Valid values: BOX, PHONE, PAD, and OTHER
parameters.name: device_class

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Leave this parameter empty for the first query. For subsequent queries, use the value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 翻页令牌，首次查询不填，后续从上次响应中获取
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页最大返回数，取值范围1~100，默认20
parameters.name: max_results
